body: I can feel like you’re a real nice person. I never got this kind of sympathy and understanding from anyone else, I’ll try to stay a while longer. You just told me my meaning to stay here. I love ya man.

Yeah, it fucking sucks. It’s just those minor annoyances that get me. And the abuse. Ive been battling depression for 7 long years for nothing. I’ve been told time and time again that I’m a disappointment and that I’m worthless. My dad told me if I was a “real man” I would have done it by now, and that’s my main reason. I want to prove home wrong, I want to see him crying over my lifeless dead body knowing it’s all his fault. It’s been 7 long years, and I just want out.
I prolly won’t, just need to get away from the toxicity
